verses.sloka: विमानात् तु सुसम्क्रम्य प्राकारम् हरि यूथपः ।हनूमान् वेगवान् आसीद् यथा विद्युद् घन अन्तरे ॥५-१३-१॥
verses.transliteration: vimānāt tu susamkramya prākāram hari yūthapaḥ ।hanūmān vegavān āsīd yathā vidyud ghana antare ॥5-13-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman, the vanara leader, jumped from the aerial chariot to the boundary wall like a flash of lightning in the clouds.

verses.sloka: सम्परिक्रम्य हनुमान् रावणस्य निवेशनान् ।अदृष्ट्वा जानकीम् सीताम् अब्रवीद् वचनम् कपिः ॥५-१३-२॥
verses.transliteration: samparikramya hanumān rāvaṇasya niveśanān ।adṛṣṭvā jānakīm sītām abravīd vacanam kapiḥ ॥5-13-2॥

translations.english: Going round the palace of Ravana, unable to see Janaka's daughter Sita, Hanuman spoke thus to himself:
translations.hindi: प्रशोकवाटिका के परकोटे की भौत पर बैठ कर," वसन्त झादि सर्ब ऋतुपों में सदा फूलने वाले विविध वृक्षों को देख, महाकपि हनमान का शरीर पुलकित हो गया

verses.sloka: भूयिष्ठम् लोडिता लन्का रामस्य चरता प्रियम् ।न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीम् सीताम् सर्व अन्ग शोभनाम् ॥५-१३-३॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyiṣṭham loḍitā lankā rāmasya caratā priyam ।na hi paśyāmi vaidehīm sītām sarva anga śobhanām ॥5-13-3॥

translations.english: "I have thoroughly surveyed the entire city of Lanka to please Rama, but I am unable to find Sita of flawless beauty.
translations.hindi: उन वृक्षों में सुन्दर साल और अशोक के पेड़ तथा भली भाँति फूले हुए चम्पा के पेड, लसोड़ा, नागंकेसर और कपि के मुख की आकृति वाले श्राम के फलों के वृक्ष थे

verses.sloka: पल्वलानि तटाकानि सराम्सि सरितः तथा ।नद्यो अनूपवन अन्ताः च दुर्गाः च धरणी धराः ॥५-१३-४॥
verses.transliteration: palvalāni taṭākāni sarāmsi saritaḥ tathā ।nadyo anūpavana antāḥ ca durgāḥ ca dharaṇī dharāḥ ॥5-13-4॥

translations.english: "I have searched for Sita thoroughly in waterlogs, lakes, tanks, streams and rivers and all over the woods and among mountains that are difficult to reach. I have searched all over the land but have not been able to find Janaki.
translations.hindi: गात्र के वन से म्रांच्छादित और सैकड़ों लताग्रों से वेष्टित उस श्रशोक वाटिका में रोदा से छुटे हुए तीर की तरह, हनुमानजी उछल कर जा पहुंचे

verses.sloka: लोडिता वसुधा सर्वा न च पश्यामि जानकीम् ।इह सम्पातिना सीता रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-१३-५॥
verses.transliteration: loḍitā vasudhā sarvā na ca paśyāmi jānakīm ।iha sampātinā sītā rāvaṇasya niveśane ॥5-13-5॥

translations.english: "Sampati, king of vultures had said that Sita is at Ravana's palace. But I have not been able to see her.
translations.hindi: वहाँ जाकर हनुमानजी ने देखा कि वह वाटिका बड़ी श्रद्‌मुत है । वहाँ वर बैठे अनेक पक्षी कलरव कर रहे हें और वे चारों श्रोर चाँदी श्रीर सोने के वृक्षों से शोभित हैं

verses.sloka: आख्याता गृध्र राजेन न च पश्यामि ताम् अहम् ।किम् नु सीता अथ वैदेही मैथिली जनक आत्मजा ॥५-१३-६॥
verses.transliteration: ākhyātā gṛdhra rājena na ca paśyāmi tām aham ।kim nu sītā atha vaidehī maithilī janaka ātmajā ॥5-13-6॥

translations.english: "Can it be that Mythili, daughter of Janaka, dejected and helpless succumbed to the evil intentions of Ravana.
translations.hindi: उसमें तरह-तरह के जीव-जन्तुम्रों श्रौर पक्षियों के कारण उसकी विचित्र शोभा हो रही थी। हनुमानजी ने वहाँ जाकर देखा कि, उदयकालीन सूर्यं की तरह उस वाटिका की शोभा हो रही है

verses.sloka: उपतिष्ठेत विवशा रावणम् दुष्ट चारिणम् ।क्षिप्रम् उत्पततो मन्ये सीताम् आदाय रक्षसः ॥५-१३-७॥
verses.transliteration: upatiṣṭheta vivaśā rāvaṇam duṣṭa cāriṇam ।kṣipram utpatato manye sītām ādāya rakṣasaḥ ॥5-13-7॥

translations.english: "Or, perhaps she might have been dropped midway from the hold of Ravana while he was flying at great speed, afraid of the deadly arrows of Rama?
translations.hindi: उसमें विविध प्रकार के फलों और फूलों के वृक्ष हैं श्रौर उन पर मतवाली कोयर्ले कूक रही हैं तथा भारे गुंजार कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: बिभ्यतो राम बाणानाम् अन्तरा पतिता भवेत् ।अथवा ह्रियमाणायाः पथि सिद्ध निषेविते ॥५-१३-८॥
verses.transliteration: bibhyato rāma bāṇānām antarā patitā bhavet ।athavā hriyamāṇāyāḥ pathi siddha niṣevite ॥5-13-8॥

translations.english: "Or, perhaps while being borne away on the path frequented by siddhas, the beloved of Rama might have fallen down (dead), heart broken, on seeing the (vast) sea.

verses.sloka: मन्ये पतितम् आर्याया हृदयम् प्रेक्ष्य सागरम् ।रावणस्य ऊरु वेगेन भुजाभ्याम् पीडितेन च ॥५-१३-९॥
verses.transliteration: manye patitam āryāyā hṛdayam prekṣya sāgaram ।rāvaṇasya ūru vegena bhujābhyām pīḍitena ca ॥5-13-9॥

translations.english: "He thinks, on account of the high speed during the flight of Ravana under the pressure of his arms, the noble, largeeyed lady might have given up her life.

verses.sloka: तया मन्ये विशाल अक्ष्या त्यक्तम् जीवितम् आर्यया ।उपरि उपरि वा नूनम् सागरम् क्रमतः तदा ॥५-१३-१०॥
verses.transliteration: tayā manye viśāla akṣyā tyaktam jīvitam āryayā ।upari upari vā nūnam sāgaram kramataḥ tadā ॥5-13-10॥

translations.english: "Surely, she might have fallen into the sea while wriggling in her effort to extricate herself from the hold of Ravana as he was flying over the sea.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने सुन्दरी ओर अनिन्दिता राजकुमारी सीता को खोजते हुए, सुख की नींद में सोते हुए वहां के पक्षियों को जगा दिया ॥। &॥। उत्पतज्हिंजगण: पक्ष: सालाः समाहताः । अनेकवर्णा विदिधा सुसुचुः पुष्पवृष्टयः

verses.sloka: विवेष्टमाना पतिता समुद्रे जनक आत्मजा ।आहो क्षुद्रेण च अनेन रक्षन्ती शीलम् आत्मनः ॥५-१३-११॥
verses.transliteration: viveṣṭamānā patitā samudre janaka ātmajā ।āho kṣudreṇa ca anena rakṣantī śīlam ātmanaḥ ॥5-13-11॥

translations.english: "Oh poor Sita, distanced from relations, while protecting her chastity helplessly she might have been devoured by cruel Ravana.

verses.sloka: अबन्धुर् भक्षिता सीता रावणेन तपस्विनी ।अथवा राक्षस इन्द्रस्य पत्नीभिर् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१३-१२॥
verses.transliteration: abandhur bhakṣitā sītā rāvaṇena tapasvinī ।athavā rākṣasa indrasya patnībhir asita īkṣaṇā ॥5-13-12॥

translations.english: "Or else, the pious, blackeyed Sita might have been eaten by the the cruelnatured wives of the lord of demons.
translations.hindi: जब हनुमानजी वृक्षों ही वृक्षों पर चढ़े हुए उस वाटिका में चारों शोर घूमने लगे, तब उन्हें देख समस्त प्राणियों ने समझा कि, वसन्त ऋतु रूप धारण करके घूम रहा है

verses.sloka: अदुष्टा दुष्ट भावाभिर् भक्षिता सा भविष्यति ।सम्पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रतिमम् पद्म पत्र निभ ईक्षणम् ॥५-१३-१३॥
verses.transliteration: aduṣṭā duṣṭa bhāvābhir bhakṣitā sā bhaviṣyati ।sampūrṇa candra pratimam padma patra nibha īkṣaṇam ॥5-13-13॥

translations.english: "Or, she might have attained death, meditating on Rama, whose face resembles the fullmoon and eyes the lotus petals.
translations.hindi: वृक्षों से गिरे हुए फूलों से ढक कर, वहाँ की भूमि श्यु्ञार की हुई स्त्री की तरह शोभायमान जान पड़ने लगी

verses.sloka: रामस्य ध्यायती वक्त्रम् पन्चत्वम् कृपणा गता ।हा राम लक्ष्मण इति एव हा अयोध्येति च मैथिली ॥५-१३-१४॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya dhyāyatī vaktram pancatvam kṛpaṇā gatā ।hā rāma lakṣmaṇa iti eva hā ayodhyeti ca maithilī ॥5-13-14॥

translations.english: "Or, Vaidehi, the princess of Mithila might have cast off her life grieving intensely and crying, 'Alas, Rama, alas, Lakshmana, alas, Ayodhya'. (Mithila is the name of the capital city and Videha is the country which was ruled by Janaka. Sita, the princess is known as Vaidehi, Mythili and Janaki).

verses.sloka: विलप्य बहु वैदेही न्यस्त देहा भविष्यति ।अथवा निहिता मन्ये रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-१३-१५॥
verses.transliteration: vilapya bahu vaidehī nyasta dehā bhaviṣyati ।athavā nihitā manye rāvaṇasya niveśane ॥5-13-15॥

translations.english: "Or, I think Sita might have been imprisoned in a cage like a myna in Ravana's palace. She will be surely crying.
translations.hindi: उनके केवल फूल ही नहीं, बल्कि पत्ते, फुनगियाँ श्रौर फल सब गिर पड़े । उस समय वे सब वृक्ष ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, जैसे जुश्रा में कपड़े-गहने हारे हुए जुवारी देख पड़ते हें

verses.sloka: नूनम् लालप्यते मन्दम् पन्जरस्था इव शारिका ।जनकस्य कुले जाता राम पत्नी सुमध्यमा ॥५-१३-१६॥
verses.transliteration: nūnam lālapyate mandam panjarasthā iva śārikā ।janakasya kule jātā rāma patnī sumadhyamā ॥5-13-16॥

translations.english: "How could Janaki, the daughter of Janaka, Rama's wife, the lady with a beautiful waist and eyes like lotus petals, come under the fold of Ravana?
translations.hindi: पवननन्दन द्वारा जोर से हिलाए हुए फूलने-फलने वाले उन उत्तम वृक्षों ने, भ्रपने-भ्रपने फूल-पत्ते तुरन्त गिरा दिये

verses.sloka: कथम् उत्पल पत्र अक्षी रावणस्य वशम् व्रजेत् ।विनष्टा वा प्रनष्टा वा मृता वा जनक आत्मजा ॥५-१३-१७॥
verses.transliteration: katham utpala patra akṣī rāvaṇasya vaśam vrajet ।vinaṣṭā vā pranaṣṭā vā mṛtā vā janaka ātmajā ॥5-13-17॥

translations.english: "Whether Janaki is lost or irretrievable or dead is not known The news should not be reported to Rama, who is very fond of his wife.
translations.hindi: पक्षियों से रहित उन वृक्षों में केवल गुद्दे ही गुद्दे रह गए । हवा द्वारा नष्ट किए हुए वृक्षों की तरह वे वृक्ष, श्रब किसी पक्षी के बैठने योग्य नहीं रह गए

verses.sloka: रामस्य प्रिय भार्यस्य न निवेदयितुम् क्षमम् ।निवेद्यमाने दोषः स्याद् दोषः स्याद् अनिवेदने ॥५-१३-१८॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya priya bhāryasya na nivedayitum kṣamam ।nivedyamāne doṣaḥ syād doṣaḥ syād anivedane ॥5-13-18॥

translations.english: "To carry or not to carry this news to Rama would be a mistake. What shall I do? I am facing a tough situation.
translations.hindi: उस समय श्रशोकवाटिका री जान पड़ती थी, जैसी वह तरुणी स्त्री जान पड़ती है जिसके सिर के बाल बिखरे हों, तिलक पोछा हुआ हो, प्रोठो में दाँत से काटने के घाव हों तथा श्रन्य श्रंगों में भी दांतों श्रौर नखों के घाव लगे हों

verses.sloka: कथम् नु खलु कर्तव्यम् विषमम् प्रतिभाति मे ।अस्मिन्न् एवम् गते कर्ये प्राप्त कालम् क्षमम् च किम् ॥५-१३-१९॥
verses.transliteration: katham nu khalu kartavyam viṣamam pratibhāti me ।asminn evam gate karye prāpta kālam kṣamam ca kim ॥5-13-19॥

translations.english: "I wonder what the right course of action is when things have taken such a turn? What is proper for me to do? Hanuman once again deliberated.

verses.sloka: भवेद् इति मतिम् भूयो हनुमान् प्रविचारयन् ।यदि सीताम् अदृष्ट्वा अहम् वानर इन्द्र पुरीम् इतः ॥५-१३-२०॥
verses.transliteration: bhaved iti matim bhūyo hanumān pravicārayan ।yadi sītām adṛṣṭvā aham vānara indra purīm itaḥ ॥5-13-20॥

translations.english: "If I return to Kishkinda without seeing Sita of what use is my effort? What have I accomplished? What will happen? (Dharma, Artha, Kama and Moksha are the four Purusharthas or accomplishments in life)
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार वर्षा ऋतु में तेज हवा मेघों को छिन्नभिन्न कर देती है; उसी प्रकार हनुमानजी ने बड़ी तेजी से वहाँ की बड़ी-बड़ी लताग्रों को छिन्नभिन्न कर डाला

verses.sloka: गमिष्यामि ततः को मे पुरुष अर्थो भविष्यति ।मम इदम् लन्घनम् व्यर्थम् सागरस्य भविष्यति ॥५-१३-२१॥
verses.transliteration: gamiṣyāmi tataḥ ko me puruṣa artho bhaviṣyati ।mama idam langhanam vyartham sāgarasya bhaviṣyati ॥5-13-21॥

translations.english: "My crossing the ocean, my entry into Lanka and my survey of the demons are all futile.

verses.sloka: प्रवेशः चिव लन्काया राक्षसानाम् च दर्शनम् ।किम् वा वक्ष्यति सुग्रीवो हरयो व समागताः ॥५-१३-२२॥
verses.transliteration: praveśaḥ civa lankāyā rākṣasānām ca darśanam ।kim vā vakṣyati sugrīvo harayo va samāgatāḥ ॥5-13-22॥

translations.english: "What will Sugriva or even the vanaras and the two sons of Dasaratha say when I reach Kishkinda?
translations.hindi: सुस्वादु मीठे जल से भरी विविध प्लाकार .प्रकार की बावली वहाँ हनुमानजी ने देखों । इन बावलियों की सीढ़ियों में बड़ी मूल्यवान मणियाँ जड़ी हुई थीं

verses.sloka: किष्किन्धाम् समनुप्राप्तौ तौ वा दशरथ आत्मजौ ।गत्वा तु यदि काकुत्स्थम् वक्ष्यामि परम् अप्रियम् ॥५-१३-२३॥
verses.transliteration: kiṣkindhām samanuprāptau tau vā daśaratha ātmajau ।gatvā tu yadi kākutstham vakṣyāmi param apriyam ॥5-13-23॥

translations.english: "If I report the most unpleasant news that Sita was not found, Rama will give up his life.
translations.hindi: उनमें मोती और मूगे ही बालू की तरह देख पड़ते थे और उनकी तली में | स्फटिक पत्थर जड़ा हुआ था। उसके तीर पर रंग-बिरंग वृक्षों के सुनहले चित्र “शोभायमान थे

verses.sloka: न दृष्टा इति मया सीता ततः त्यक्ष्यन्ति जीवितम् ।परुषम् दारुणम् क्रूरम् तीक्ष्णम् इन्द्रिय तापनम् ॥५-१३-२४॥
verses.transliteration: na dṛṣṭā iti mayā sītā tataḥ tyakṣyanti jīvitam ।paruṣam dāruṇam krūram tīkṣṇam indriya tāpanam ॥5-13-24॥

translations.english: Hearing harsh, dreadful, cruel and sense-scorching evil tidings about Sita, Rama will not survive.

verses.sloka: सीता निमित्तम् दुर्वाक्यम् श्रुत्वा स न भविष्यति ।तम् तु कृच्च्र गतम् दृष्ट्वा पन्चत्व गत मानसम् ॥५-१३-२५॥
verses.transliteration: sītā nimittam durvākyam śrutvā sa na bhaviṣyati ।tam tu kṛccra gatam dṛṣṭvā pancatva gata mānasam ॥5-13-25॥

translations.english: "Seeing Rama in such a painful state, wise Lakshmana who has given his life to Rama, to whom he is deeply devoted will also not survive.
translations.hindi: उन वापियों के चारों झोर बड़े-बड़े वृक्ष लगे थे श्रौर छोटी-छोटी नदियाँ बह रही थीं । उन वापियों में अमृतोपम-स्वादिष्ट जल भरा हुग्रा था जो भीतरी सोतों से उन वापियों में पहुँचा करता था

verses.sloka: भृश अनुरक्तो मेधावी न भविष्यति लक्ष्मणः ।विनष्टौ भ्रातरौ श्रुत्वा भरतो अपि मरिष्यति ॥५-१३-२६॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛśa anurakto medhāvī na bhaviṣyati lakṣmaṇaḥ ।vinaṣṭau bhrātarau śrutvā bharato api mariṣyati ॥5-13-26॥

translations.english: "On hearing the death of both the brothers Bharata will also die. On seeing this Satrughna will also not live.
translations.hindi: उनके ऊपर लता के मण्डप बने हुए थे प्रौर वे कल्पवृक्ष के फूलों से घिरे हुए थे । विविध गुच्छों से उनका जल ढेंका हुश्रा था आर करवीर से उनके बीच. में छिद्र से बने हुये थे

verses.sloka: भरतम् च मृतम् दृष्ट्वा शत्रुघ्नो न भविष्यति ।पुत्रान् मृतान् समीक्ष्य अथ न भविष्यन्ति मातरः ॥५-१३-२७॥
verses.transliteration: bharatam ca mṛtam dṛṣṭvā śatrughno na bhaviṣyati ।putrān mṛtān samīkṣya atha na bhaviṣyanti mātaraḥ ॥5-13-27॥

translations.english: Seeing their sons dead, the mothers Kausalya, Sumitra and Kaikeyi will surely not survive—there is no doubt.
translations.hindi: मेघ के समान उच्च सिंखरों वाला एक श्रद्भुत पर्वत वहाँ चारों श्रोर कैला हुआ था

verses.sloka: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च न सम्शयः ।कृतज्ञः सत्य सम्धः च सुग्रीवः प्लवग अधिपः ॥५-१३-२८॥
verses.transliteration: kausalyā ca sumitrā ca kaikeyī ca na samśayaḥ ।kṛtajñaḥ satya samdhaḥ ca sugrīvaḥ plavaga adhipaḥ ॥5-13-28॥

translations.english: "On seeing that Rama has ended his life, the grateful and truthful monkey leader, Sugriva will give up his life.
translations.hindi: उस पर्वत में अनेक पत्थर के गुफानुमा घर बने हुए थे, जिनके चारों श्रोर प्रनेक वृक्ष थे । संसार भर के पवंतों में रमणीक इस पर्वत को हनुमानजी ने देखा

verses.sloka: रामम् तथा गतम् दृष्ट्वा ततः त्यक्ष्यन्ति जीवितम् ।दुर्मना व्यथिता दीना निरानन्दा तपस्विनी ॥५-१३-२९॥
verses.transliteration: rāmam tathā gatam dṛṣṭvā tataḥ tyakṣyanti jīvitam ।durmanā vyathitā dīnā nirānandā tapasvinī ॥5-13-29॥

translations.english: "Distressed, disheartened, pained and grieved on account of her husband's death, the virtuous lady Ruma (wife of Sugriva) will be unhappy and die.
translations.hindi: शिवार्भि:--स्रिम््रिः उपसंस्कृताः नित्य पूर्णत्वाय प्रापिताः । ( शि० ) १५४ सुन्दरकाण्डे इस पर्वत से त्तिकल कर एक नदी बह रही थी हनुमानजी को बह्‌ ऐसी जान पड़ी मानो, कोई प्रियतमा कामिनी कुपित हो श्रपने प्रियतम की गोद को त्याग कर, भूमि पर गिर पड़ी हो

verses.sloka: पीडिता भर्तृ शोकेन रुमा त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम् ।वालिजेन तु दुह्खेन पीडिता शोक कर्शिता ॥५-१३-३०॥
verses.transliteration: pīḍitā bhartṛ śokena rumā tyakṣyati jīvitam ।vālijena tu duhkhena pīḍitā śoka karśitā ॥5-13-30॥

translations.english: "Tara who is troubled by Vali's death and tortured with grief will not live when king Sugriva dies.
translations.hindi: जेसे कोई मानिनी कामिनी कुपित हो श्रपने प्रियतम को त्याग श्रन्यत्र जाना चाहे भ्रौर उसकी प्यारी सखी-सहेलियां उसे रोक रही हों, वैसे ही उस नदी के तीरवर्ती वृक्षों की डालियां जल में डूबी हुई इसी भाव को प्रदर्शित कर रही थीं

verses.sloka: पन्चत्व गमने राज्ञः तारा अपि न भविष्यति ।माता पित्रोर् विनाशेन सुग्रीव व्यसनेन च ॥५-१३-३१॥
verses.transliteration: pancatva gamane rājñaḥ tārā api na bhaviṣyati ।mātā pitror vināśena sugrīva vyasanena ca ॥5-13-31॥

translations.english: "On account of his parents death and also because of Sugriva's calamity, Angada will give up his life.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी ने देखा कि कुछ दूर जाकर नदी का जल पुनः पीछे भ्रा रहा है । मानो वह रूठी हुई कामिनी प्रसन्न होकर लौट कर प्रियतम के समीप श्रा रही है

verses.sloka: कुमारो अपि अन्गदः कस्माद् धारयिष्यति जीवितम् ।भर्तृजेन तु शोकेन अभिभूता वन ओकसः ॥५-१३-३२॥
verses.transliteration: kumāro api angadaḥ kasmād dhārayiṣyati jīvitam ।bhartṛjena tu śokena abhibhūtā vana okasaḥ ॥5-13-32॥

translations.english: "The grief due to the death of their king will make the vanaras hit their heads with their palms and fists.
translations.hindi: पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने देखा कि, उस नदी से कुछ दूर हट कर, भ्रनेक | जाति के पक्षियों से युक्त और कमल के फूलों से शोभित एक पुष्करिणी | है

verses.sloka: शिराम्सि अभिहनिष्यन्ति तलैर् मुष्टिभिर् एव च ।सान्त्वेन अनुप्रदानेन मानेन च यशस्विना ॥५-१३-३३॥
verses.transliteration: śirāmsi abhihaniṣyanti talair muṣṭibhir eva ca ।sāntvena anupradānena mānena ca yaśasvinā ॥5-13-33॥

translations.english: "The vanaras who were reared by the king's kind words, gifts and care will give up their life.
translations.hindi: फिर हनुमान जी ने एक बनावटी भ्रौर लम्बा-चौड़ा सरोवर भी देखा, जो ठंडे जल से परिपूर्ण था और जिसकी सीढ़ियाँ मणिमयी थीं । वे मुक्तारूपी | बालू से शोभित थीं

verses.sloka: लालिताः कपि राजेन प्राणामः त्यक्ष्यन्ति वानराः ।न वनेषु न शैलेषु न निरोधेषु वा पुनः ॥५-१३-३४॥
verses.transliteration: lālitāḥ kapi rājena prāṇāmaḥ tyakṣyanti vānarāḥ ।na vaneṣu na śaileṣu na nirodheṣu vā punaḥ ॥5-13-34॥

translations.english: "The chiefs among vanaras together will not enjoy their life in the forest or mountains or caves.
translations.hindi: ह अनेक प्रकार के मृगों से श्रौर चित्र विचित्र वनों से पूर्ण तथा ग्रनेक बहुत बड़े-बड़े भवनों से शोभित, उस वाटिका को विद्वकर्मा ने बनाया था

verses.sloka: क्रीडाम् अनुभविष्यन्ति समेत्य कपि कुन्जराः ।सपुत्र दाराः सामात्या भर्तृ व्यसन पीडिताः ॥५-१३-३५॥
verses.transliteration: krīḍām anubhaviṣyanti sametya kapi kunjarāḥ ।saputra dārāḥ sāmātyā bhartṛ vyasana pīḍitāḥ ॥5-13-35॥

translations.english: "Tormented by their king's death the vanaras with their wives, sons and ministers will drop down from the mountain peaks on the rough ground and die.
translations.hindi: नकली वनों से वह चारों श्रोर से सजाई गयौ थी । वहाँ जितने फूलने श्रौर फलने वाले वृक्ष लगे थे

verses.sloka: शैल अग्रेभ्यः पतिष्यन्ति समेत्य विषमेषु च ।विषम् उद्बन्धनम् वा अपि प्रवेशम् ज्वलनस्य वा ॥५-१३-३६॥
verses.transliteration: śaila agrebhyaḥ patiṣyanti sametya viṣameṣu ca ।viṣam udbandhanam vā api praveśam jvalanasya vā ॥5-13-36॥

translations.english: "The vanaras will put an end to their lives by poisoning or by hanging or by selfimmolation or by killing themselves with weapons or by fasting unto death.
translations.hindi: वे सब छाते की तरह ऊपर से फेले हुए छाया किए हुए थे, उनके चारों ग्रोर' चबूतर बने हुए थे, जिन पर चढ़ने के लिए सोने की सीढ़ियाँ थीं । वहाँ श्रनेक लताग्नों के जाल से छाए हुए थे जिनके पत्तों से वहाँ छाया बनी रहती थी

verses.sloka: उपवासम् अथो शस्त्रम् प्रचरिष्यन्ति वानराः ।घोरम् आरोदनम् मन्ये गते मयि भविष्यति ॥५-१३-३७॥
verses.transliteration: upavāsam atho śastram pracariṣyanti vānarāḥ ।ghoram ārodanam manye gate mayi bhaviṣyati ॥5-13-37॥

translations.english: "If I go there (without finding Sita), it will cause destruction of the Ikshvakus and vanaras would weep. It would be dreadful.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर हनुमानजी ने सुनहले रङ्ग का शिशुपा वृक्ष देखा । उसका थेंबला) सोने का वना हुआ था

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकु कुल नाशः च नाशः चैव वन ओकसाम् ।सो अहम् न एव गमिष्यामि किष्किन्धाम् नगरीम् इतः ॥५-१३-३८॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣvāku kula nāśaḥ ca nāśaḥ caiva vana okasām ।so aham na eva gamiṣyāmi kiṣkindhām nagarīm itaḥ ॥5-13-38॥

translations.english: "I will not go to the city of Kishkinda from here or to Sugriva without finding Mythili. It will not be possible for me to face him.

verses.sloka: न हि शक्ष्यामि अहम् द्रष्टुम् सुग्रीवम् मैथिलीम् विना ।मयि अगच्चति च इहस्थे धर्म आत्मानौ महा रथौ ॥५-१३-३९॥
verses.transliteration: na hi śakṣyāmi aham draṣṭum sugrīvam maithilīm vinā ।mayi agaccati ca ihasthe dharma ātmānau mahā rathau ॥5-13-39॥

translations.english: Both the highsouled warrior princes treading a righteous path as well as the vanaras will survive with a hope of my return if I stay back.

verses.sloka: आशया तौ धरिष्येते वनराः च मनस्विनः ।हस्त आदानो मुख आदानो नियतो वृक्ष मूलिकः ॥५-१३-४०॥
verses.transliteration: āśayā tau dhariṣyete vanarāḥ ca manasvinaḥ ।hasta ādāno mukha ādāno niyato vṛkṣa mūlikaḥ ॥5-13-40॥

translations.english: "If Janaki is not found I will stay here and live like a hermit subsisting on whatever is available on this sea shore, which has abundance of roots, fruits and water.
translations.hindi: जब वे पेड़ वायु के झोके से हिले, तब उनमें से असंख्य घुंघुरुओों के एक साथ झनकारने का शब्द हुआ । इससे हनुमानजी को बड़ा ग्राइचर्य हुआ

verses.sloka: वानप्रस्थो भविष्यामि अदृष्ट्वा जनक आत्मजाम् ।सागर अनूपजे देशे बहु मूल फल उदके ॥५-१३-४१॥
verses.transliteration: vānaprastho bhaviṣyāmi adṛṣṭvā janaka ātmajām ।sāgara anūpaje deśe bahu mūla phala udake ॥5-13-41॥

translations.english: "If Janaki is not found I will stay here and live like a hermit subsisting on whatever is available on this sea shore, which has abundance of roots, fruits and water.
translations.hindi: सुन्दर पुष्पों वाले, नवीन अंकुरों तथा पत्तों से युक्त, दीप्तिमान्‌ उन वृक्षों में से उस शिशुपा वृक्ष पर हनुमानजी चढ़ गए और उसके पत्तों में अपने को छिपा लिया

verses.sloka: चिताम् कृत्वा प्रवेक्ष्यामि समिद्धम् अरणी सुतम् ।उपविष्टस्य वा सम्यग् लिन्गिनम् साधयिष्यतः ॥५-१३-४२॥
verses.transliteration: citām kṛtvā pravekṣyāmi samiddham araṇī sutam ।upaviṣṭasya vā samyag linginam sādhayiṣyataḥ ॥5-13-42॥

translations.english: "I will prepare a pyre and enter the fire so that sea waves wash off the ashes or crows and beasts will eat up my body while i sit fasting unto death.
translations.hindi: वहाँ बैठ वे विचारने लगे कि, यहाँ से कदाचित्‌ में सीता को देर सकू । क्योंकि दुःख से विकल हो, वह श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के दर्शन की लालसा किए हुए, इधर-उधर घूमती देवात्‌ इधर श्रा निकलें

verses.sloka: शरीरम् भक्षयिष्यन्ति वायसाः श्वापदानि च ।इदम् अपि ऋषिभिर् दृष्टम् निर्याणम् इति मे मतिः ॥५-१३-४३॥
verses.transliteration: śarīram bhakṣayiṣyanti vāyasāḥ śvāpadāni ca ।idam api ṛṣibhir dṛṣṭam niryāṇam iti me matiḥ ॥5-13-43॥

translations.english: "I shall enter water and drown myself to death if I am not able to find Janaki. I think this way of ending life has been suggested by great ascetics.
translations.hindi: यह रावण की अ्शोकवाटिका अति रमणीक है । चन्दन, चंपा और मौलसिरी के वृक्ष इसकी शोभा बढ़ा रहे हें

verses.sloka: सम्यग् आपः प्रवेक्ष्यामि न चेत् पश्यामि जानकीम् ।सुजात मूला सुभगा कीर्ति माला यशस्विनी ॥५-१३-४४॥
verses.transliteration: samyag āpaḥ pravekṣyāmi na cet paśyāmi jānakīm ।sujāta mūlā subhagā kīrti mālā yaśasvinī ॥5-13-44॥

translations.english: My glory which had a good start (in the form of bringing Rama to Sugriva) and brought fortune to Sugriva and fame to me has been snapped as I could not find Sita.
translations.hindi: यह पुष्करिणी भी कमलो से पूर्ण है और इसके चारों ओर बैठे हुए पक्षी भी इसकी शोभा बढ़ा रहे ह्‌ । अतः श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की महिषी सीता यहाँ ग्रवश्य आवेंगी

verses.sloka: प्रभग्ना चिर रात्री इयम् मम सीताम् अपश्यतः ।तापसो वा भविष्यामि नियतो वृक्ष मूलिकः ॥५-१३-४५॥
verses.transliteration: prabhagnā cira rātrī iyam mama sītām apaśyataḥ ।tāpaso vā bhaviṣyāmi niyato vṛkṣa mūlikaḥ ॥5-13-45॥

translations.english: "I will remain an ascetic and do penance under the tree practising selfcontrol and not go back without seeing the blackeyed Sita.

verses.sloka: न इतः प्रतिगमिष्यामि ताम् अदृष्ट्वा असित ईक्षणाम् ।यदि इतः प्रतिगच्चामि सीताम् अनधिगम्य ताम् ॥५-१३-४६॥
verses.transliteration: na itaḥ pratigamiṣyāmi tām adṛṣṭvā asita īkṣaṇām ।yadi itaḥ pratigaccāmi sītām anadhigamya tām ॥5-13-46॥

translations.english: "Besides, if I go back without finding Sita all the vanaras including Angada will die.
translations.hindi: अथवा वनविचरणप्रिया मृगशावकनयनी सोता वन सम्बन्धी ढूढ-खोज मे चतुर है, सो वह श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की चिता में विकल हो श्रौर उस चिंता को कमः करने के लिए बहुत सम्भव है, यहाँ भ्रावे

verses.sloka: अन्गदः सहितैः सर्वैर् वानरैर् न भविष्यति ।विनाशे बहवो दोषा जीवन् प्राप्नोति भद्रकम् ॥५-१३-४७॥
verses.transliteration: angadaḥ sahitaiḥ sarvair vānarair na bhaviṣyati ।vināśe bahavo doṣā jīvan prāpnoti bhadrakam ॥5-13-47॥

translations.english: "If I commit suicide, I will earn numerous sins. By being alive, I can witness auspicious events. Therefore, I will live, for, happiness can come only to the living.
translations.hindi: वह वामलोचना सीता, श्रीरामचंद्रजी के वियोगजनित शोक से संतप्त है आर वनवास का उसे ग्रभ्यास है, अतः उस वनचारिणी का इधर भ्राना सम्भव है

verses.sloka: तस्मात् प्राणान् धरिष्यामि ध्रुवो जीवति सम्गमः ।एवम् बहु विधम् दुह्खम् मनसा धारयन् मुहुः ॥५-१३-४८॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt prāṇān dhariṣyāmi dhruvo jīvati samgamaḥ ।evam bahu vidham duhkham manasā dhārayan muhuḥ ॥5-13-48॥

translations.english: The elephant among monkeys (Hanuman) worrying over and over again, holding his head for long could not reach the end of his grief.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचंद्रजी की प्रिय भार्या और सती जनकनन्दिनी, वन के मृगों और पक्षियों पर प्रति प्रेम रखती थी

verses.sloka: न अध्यगच्चत् तदा पारम् शोकस्य कपि कुन्जरः ।रावणम् वा वधिष्यामि दशग्रीवम् महा बलम् ॥५-१३-४९॥
verses.transliteration: na adhyagaccat tadā pāram śokasya kapi kunjaraḥ ।rāvaṇam vā vadhiṣyāmi daśagrīvam mahā balam ॥5-13-49॥

translations.english: "I will kill Ravana, this mighty, tenheaded demon. Sita was indeed carried away by him. This (killing him) can be a fitting reply to his evil action. My desire would be fulfilled.

verses.sloka: कामम् अस्तु हृता सीता प्रत्याचीर्णम् भविष्यति ।अथवा एनम् समुत्क्षिप्य उपरि उपरि सागरम् ॥५-१३-५०॥
verses.transliteration: kāmam astu hṛtā sītā pratyācīrṇam bhaviṣyati ।athavā enam samutkṣipya upari upari sāgaram ॥5-13-50॥

translations.english: "Or else, I shall carry him across the sea and put him before Rama like a bull as if he is a sacrificial prey to lord Siva."
translations.hindi: प्रात: और संध्याकाल में स्नान, जप श्रादि करने वाली तथा सदा सोलह वषं जेसी देख पड़ने वाली तथा सु दर वर्ण वाली जानकी, इस नदी के स्वच्छ जल में स्नानादि तथा *ईशवरोपासना करने श्रवदय श्रावेगी ।! ४९ ॥। १ वनस्यास्य विचक्षणा --वनसम्बन्ध्यन्वेषणादिकुशला । (गो०) # “सन्ध्याथे” का श्रर्थ टीकाकारों ने ईदवरोपासना इसलिए किया है कि, घमंशास्त्रों ने स्त्रियों को, पुरूषों की तरह वैदिक विधि विघान से सन्घ्योपासन करने का श्रधिकार नहीं दिया । तस्याश्चाप्यनुरूपेयमशोकवनिका शुभा ३ शुभा या पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य पत्नी रामस्य संमता

verses.sloka: रामाय उपहरिष्यामि पशुम् पशु पतेर् इव ।इति चिन्ता समापन्नः सीताम् अनधिगम्य ताम् ॥५-१३-५१॥
verses.transliteration: rāmāya upahariṣyāmi paśum paśu pater iva ।iti cintā samāpannaḥ sītām anadhigamya tām ॥5-13-51॥

translations.english: Distressed over his inability to find Sita, Hanuman's mind was overcome with anxiety and he started thinking further.
translations.hindi: यदि वह चन्द्राननी जानकी बची जोती हैं; तो वह शुभ या शुद्ध जल वाली इस नदी के तट पर श्रवश्य ही आवेगी

verses.sloka: ध्यान शोका परीत आत्मा चिन्तयाम् आस वानरः ।यावत् सीताम् न पश्यामि राम पत्नीम् यशस्विनीम् ॥५-१३-५२॥
verses.transliteration: dhyāna śokā parīta ātmā cintayām āsa vānaraḥ ।yāvat sītām na paśyāmi rāma patnīm yaśasvinīm ॥5-13-52॥

translations.english: "Till I find the virtuous Sita, wife of Rama in this Lanka, I shall keep searching everywhere again and again.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार महात्मा हनुमानजी उस फूले हुए शिंशपावृक्ष के घने पत्तों में अपने को छिपाए, सीता के प्राने की प्रतीक्षा करते हुए ्रौर चारों श्रोर आँख पैला कर देखते हुए, बैठे रहे

verses.sloka: तावद् एताम् पुरीम् लन्काम् विचिनोमि पुनः पुनः ।सम्पाति वचनाच् च अपि रामम् यदि आनयामि अहम् ॥५-१३-५३॥
verses.transliteration: tāvad etām purīm lankām vicinomi punaḥ punaḥ ।sampāti vacanāc ca api rāmam yadi ānayāmi aham ॥5-13-53॥

translations.english: "Had I brought Raghava following the words of Sampati, Rama would have burnt all vanaras unable to find his wife.

verses.sloka: अपश्यन् राघवो भार्याम् निर्दहेत् सर्व वानरान् ।इह एव नियत आहारो वत्स्यामि नियत इन्द्रियः ॥५-१३-५४॥
verses.transliteration: apaśyan rāghavo bhāryām nirdahet sarva vānarān ।iha eva niyata āhāro vatsyāmi niyata indriyaḥ ॥5-13-54॥

translations.english: "I will stay here itself, restricting my food and controlling my senses. Let not men and monkeys perish for my fault.

verses.sloka: न मत् कृते विनश्येयुः सर्वे ते नर वानराः ।अशोक वनिका च अपि महती इयम् महा द्रुमा ॥५-१३-५५॥
verses.transliteration: na mat kṛte vinaśyeyuḥ sarve te nara vānarāḥ ।aśoka vanikā ca api mahatī iyam mahā drumā ॥5-13-55॥

translations.english: "Here is the Ashoka grove with huge trees. I will go there. I have not looked for her in this place.

verses.sloka: इमाम् अभिगमिष्यामि न हि इयम् विचिता मया ।वसून् रुद्रामः तथा आदित्यान् अश्विनौ मरुतो अपि च ॥५-१३-५६॥
verses.transliteration: imām abhigamiṣyāmi na hi iyam vicitā mayā ।vasūn rudrāmaḥ tathā ādityān aśvinau maruto api ca ॥5-13-56॥

translations.english: "I shall offer salutations to Vasus, Rudras Adityas and Aswinis and proceed to increase (cause) the sorrow of the demons. (There are eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, two Ashwins and fortynine Windgods).

verses.sloka: नमः कृत्वा गमिष्यामि रक्षसाम् शोक वर्धनः ।जित्वा तु राक्षसान् देवीम् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दिनीम् ॥५-१३-५७॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi rakṣasām śoka vardhanaḥ ।jitvā tu rākṣasān devīm ikṣvāku kula nandinīm ॥5-13-57॥

translations.english: "I will conquer all the ogres and pass them to Sita, the delight of the Ikshvaku family as an offering and give Rama to her as the fruit of her austerities."

verses.sloka: सम्प्रदास्यामि रामाया यथा सिद्धिम् तपस्विने ।स मुहूर्तम् इव ध्यात्वा चिन्ता विग्रथित इन्द्रियः ॥५-१३-५८॥
verses.transliteration: sampradāsyāmi rāmāyā yathā siddhim tapasvine ।sa muhūrtam iva dhyātvā cintā vigrathita indriyaḥ ॥5-13-58॥

translations.english: The brilliant son of the Windgod, Hanuman, whose senses were overwhelmed with worries, regained his senses in a short while and got up.

verses.sloka: उदतिष्ठन् महा बाहुर् हनूमान् मारुत आत्मजः ।नमो अस्तु रामाय सलक्ष्मणाय ।देव्यै च तस्यै जनक आत्मजायै ।नमो अस्तु रुद्र इन्द्र यम अनिलेभ्यो ।नमो अस्तु चन्द्र अर्क मरुद् गणेभ्यः ॥५-१३-५९॥
verses.transliteration: udatiṣṭhan mahā bāhur hanūmān māruta ātmajaḥ ।namo astu rāmāya salakṣmaṇāya ।devyai ca tasyai janaka ātmajāyai ।namo astu rudra indra yama anilebhyo ।namo astu candra arka marud gaṇebhyaḥ ॥5-13-59॥

translations.english: "My salutations to Lakshmana, Rama and divine daughter of Janaka. Salutations to Rudra, Indra, Yama and Vayu. Salutations to Sun, Moon and Maruts"

verses.sloka: स तेभ्यः तु नमः कृत्वा सुग्रीवाय च मारुतिः ।दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य अशोक वनिकाम् प्रति ॥५-१३-६०॥
verses.transliteration: sa tebhyaḥ tu namaḥ kṛtvā sugrīvāya ca mārutiḥ ।diśaḥ sarvāḥ samālokya aśoka vanikām prati ॥5-13-60॥

translations.english: Having offered salutations to all gods as well as to Sugriva, he looked at all quarters and left for the Ashoka grove.

verses.sloka: स गत्वा मनसा पूर्वम् अशोक वनिकाम् शुभाम् ।उत्तरम् चिन्तयाम् आस वानरो मारुत आत्मजः ॥५-१३-६१॥
verses.transliteration: sa gatvā manasā pūrvam aśoka vanikām śubhām ।uttaram cintayām āsa vānaro māruta ātmajaḥ ॥5-13-61॥

translations.english: Hanuman started thinking again about his task after reaching the auspicious Ashoka grove.

verses.sloka: ध्रुवम् तु रक्षो बहुला भविष्यति वन आकुला ।अशोक वनिका चिन्त्या सर्व सम्स्कार सम्स्कृता ॥५-१३-६२॥
verses.transliteration: dhruvam tu rakṣo bahulā bhaviṣyati vana ākulā ।aśoka vanikā cintyā sarva samskāra samskṛtā ॥5-13-62॥

translations.english: 'This Ashoka grove filled with many trees, guarded by many demons is carefully tended. It must be sacred.

verses.sloka: रक्षिणः च अत्र विहिता नूनम् रक्षन्ति पादपान् ।भगवान् अपि सर्व आत्मा न अतिक्षोभम् प्रवायति ॥५-१३-६३॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣiṇaḥ ca atra vihitā nūnam rakṣanti pādapān ।bhagavān api sarva ātmā na atikṣobham pravāyati ॥5-13-63॥

translations.english: "The guards posted there are surely protecting the grove. The divinity pervading all over me (the wind) must also have been controlled as it is also not blowing violently. I have turned my body small for Rama's cause and also to save myself from Ravana.

verses.sloka: सम्क्षिप्तो अयम् मया आत्मा च राम अर्थे रावणस्य च ।सिद्धिम् मे सम्विधास्यन्ति देवाः सर्षि गणाः त्व् इह ॥५-१३-६४॥
verses.transliteration: samkṣipto ayam mayā ātmā ca rāma arthe rāvaṇasya ca ।siddhim me samvidhāsyanti devāḥ sarṣi gaṇāḥ tv iha ॥5-13-64॥

translations.english: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर् भगवान् देवाः चैव दिशन्तु मे ।सिद्धिम् अग्निः च वायुः च पुरु हूतः च वज्रधृत् ॥५-१३-६५॥
verses.transliteration: brahmā svayambhūr bhagavān devāḥ caiva diśantu me ।siddhim agniḥ ca vāyuḥ ca puru hūtaḥ ca vajradhṛt ॥5-13-65॥

translations.english: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

verses.sloka: वरुणः पाश हस्तः च सोम आदित्यै तथैव च ।अश्विनौ च महात्मानौ मरुतः सर्व एव च ॥५-१३-६६॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ pāśa hastaḥ ca soma ādityai tathaiva ca ।aśvinau ca mahātmānau marutaḥ sarva eva ca ॥5-13-66॥

translations.english: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

verses.sloka: सिद्धिम् सर्वाणि भूतानि भूतानाम् चैव यः प्रभुः ।दास्यन्ति मम ये च अन्ये अदृष्टाः पथि गोचराः ॥५-१३-६७॥
verses.transliteration: siddhim sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhūtānām caiva yaḥ prabhuḥ ।dāsyanti mama ye ca anye adṛṣṭāḥ pathi gocarāḥ ॥5-13-67॥

translations.english: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

verses.sloka: तद् उन्नसम् पाण्डुर दन्तम् अव्रणम् ।शुचि स्मितम् पद्म पलाश लोचनम् ।द्रक्ष्ये तद् आर्या वदनम् कदा न्व् अहम् ।प्रसन्न तारा अधिप तुल्य दर्शनम् ॥५-१३-६८॥
verses.transliteration: tad unnasam pāṇḍura dantam avraṇam ।śuci smitam padma palāśa locanam ।drakṣye tad āryā vadanam kadā nv aham ।prasanna tārā adhipa tulya darśanam ॥5-13-68॥

translations.english: 'Oh when and how would I behold that beautiful noble lady of stainless character, with a Moonlike face, prominent nose, white teeth, pleasant smile and with eyes like lotus petals?

verses.sloka: क्षुद्रेण पापेन नृशम्स कर्मणा ।सुदारुण अलाम्कृत वेष धारिणा।बल अभिभूता अबला तपस्विनी ।कथम् नु मे दृष्ट पथे अद्य सा भवेत् ॥५-१३-६९॥
verses.transliteration: kṣudreṇa pāpena nṛśamsa karmaṇā ।sudāruṇa alāmkṛta veṣa dhāriṇā।bala abhibhūtā abalā tapasvinī ।katham nu me dṛṣṭa pathe adya sā bhavet ॥5-13-69॥

translations.english: "How will I set my eyes on that gentle, frail and suffering thing now, who has been abducted by that mean, cruel sinner of dreadful look?" इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
